Material 3 package fonts
========================

The specialization (material3.spec.json) declares Roboto in "fonts":

  - fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf (weight 400)
  - fonts/Roboto-Medium.ttf  (weight 500)

The .ttf files are NOT in the repository (license and size). Roboto is licensed
under Apache 2.0 and can be downloaded at https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto
("Get font" / "Download all" button); copy the two files above into this folder,
with those names.

Without the files, the drawing falls back to the system font and Diagnostics shows a warning
for each missing font. The package stays valid.
